features.title: cost-lib: transcript usage, snapshot deltas, prices, unknown runtimes
features.user_visible_behavior: Token usage per model is read from a Claude transcript (deduplicated by message id) and aggregated per slice, phase, model and runtime from Stop spans; USD only from the project price table; runtimes without data are unknown.
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: node --test cli/src/harness/cost-lib.test.mjs 7/7 (transcript dedup by message id, file guards, 8-model cap, snapshot deltas per slice/phase/model/runtime with reset baseline, USD from the project table with null propagation, empty-data contract, unknown runtimes); registered in npm test.

features.title: Stop hook records Claude transcript usage on its span
features.user_visible_behavior: On a Claude Stop, the single verify-on-stop hook span carries the session's cumulative usage per model; a missing or unreadable transcript changes nothing else.
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: verify-on-stop.test.mjs 5/5 — new 'cost-metrics REQ-001' (Claude Stop span carries usage {session_id, models} deduped by message id, schema-valid, still one span; Cursor and an unreadable transcript add no usage) plus the 4 TASK-006 fail-open/ordering tests unchanged.

features.title: metrics.cost in status --metrics/--json/--html
features.user_visible_behavior: asdd status --metrics shows tokens and cost per slice, phase, model and runtime (unknown runtimes listed); --json carries metrics.cost; --html and asdd ui show the same.
